# Oráculo (Oraculo-Desk)

> Peer-to-peer remote desktop, interactive PTY terminal, quick commands, and home-sandboxed file browser over `iroh` encrypted QUIC (`ALPN: oraculo/1`), written in Rust (edition 2024) and Kotlin (Jetpack Compose).

## Documentation & Policies

- [English README](../README.md): Architecture overview, platform support matrix, CLI commands, security model, and Podman build workflow.
- [Portuguese README](../README.pt-BR.md): Documentação completa em Português (Brasil).
- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Workspace boundaries, build commands, and critical invariants for automated tooling.
- [Security Policy](SECURITY.md): Security model and vulnerability reporting guidance.
- [License (Apache-2.0)](../licenses/LICENSE): License text and [third-party notices](../licenses/NOTICE).

## Workspace Crates

- [`crates/oraculo-proto`](../crates/oraculo-proto): Length-prefixed `postcard` protocol (`MAX_FRAME_SIZE = 4 MiB`, `FILE_CHUNK_SIZE = 128 KiB`), `StreamKind` (`Pair=1`, `Control=2`, `Terminal=3`, `Input=4`, `Files=5`, `Screen=6`), and `ControlRequest`/`ControlResponse`.
- [`crates/oraculo-host`](../crates/oraculo-host): Host daemon (`serve [--pair]`, `peers`, `revoke`, `permissions`, `info`, `monitors`), Linux Wayland `xdg-desktop-portal` ScreenCast (PipeWire + GStreamer H.264) and RemoteDesktop input, `portable-pty` terminal, `commands.toml` runner, and `~` file sandbox.
- [`crates/oraculo-cli`](../crates/oraculo-cli): Terminal client (`pair`, `ping`, `commands`, `run`, `shell`).
- [`crates/oraculo-mobile-core`](../crates/oraculo-mobile-core): UniFFI-exported (`OraculoMobileClient`) QUIC connection pool, `vt100` terminal parser, H.264 NAL normalizer, and file transfer engine for Android `arm64-v8a`.
- [`android/`](../android/): Jetpack Compose client (`minSdk = 26`, `targetSdk = 35`) with hardware `MediaCodec` video decoder, bilingual `PT`/`EN` UI, `Touchpad`/`Terminal`/`Commands`/`Files` tabs, and foreground session service.
